Hymn 166: Abide with Me!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: William H. Monk
Lyricist/Text Author: Henry F. Lyte
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 166 titled "Abide with Me!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William H. Monk and the lyrics were written by Henry F. Lyte.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
